metadata.scenario: A potential client requests a price quote for group training sessions. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I’m calling to ask about group training sessions. Hi Mary! Great to hear from you. Could you tell me more about the training sessions you're interested in? Yes, I'm looking for group training for caregivers, specifically focusing on IV therapy. That sounds like a valuable training. How many caregivers are you looking to train? We’re looking at about ten people, including some new staff. Perfect! We can certainly accommodate that. Would you like this to be conducted in-person or virtually? In-person would be best for hands-on practice. Understood. For ten people, our pricing would be $1,200 for a full-day session. That seems reasonable. What topics will be covered? The session will include IV administration techniques, patient assessment, and managing complications. That sounds comprehensive. Can we schedule this for next month? Sure! I recommend we check availability for the second week of next month. That works for me. Can I also get a copy of the training materials? Absolutely! I’ll make sure to send those over after the training session. Great! Can you confirm the total price again? Yes, the total price for the session with ten participants is $1,200. Perfect! I’d like to go ahead and book that. Excellent choice! I’ll need to take some details from you to finalize the booking. Sure, what do you need? I’ll need the full name of the organization, a contact person, and an email address for the confirmation. It’s Mary O'Connor, CareFirst Home Health, and my email is mary.oconnor@email.com. Thank you, Mary. I’ll send a confirmation email shortly. Any other questions? No, that’s all for now. Thanks for your help! You’re welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
